title: Multi-turn dialogue simulation benchmark record
description: Schema for one record in data/multi_turn.jsonl. Each record defines the context and process constraints for a complete medical follow-up dialogue simulation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the record within this dataset.

script_name.description: Name of the disease-specific follow-up script.

patient_profile.description: De-identified patient profile. An empty string means that no profile was supplied for the case.

flow_requirements.description: Complete follow-up flow and branching requirements.

information_nodes.description: Ordered information nodes that the simulated dialogue should cover.

detailed_flow_requirements.description: Detailed branching, follow-up, and safety requirements for the dialogue.

source_file.description: Repository-relative provenance label for the source file.
